This directory holds repository-wide reference material that should not be duplicated into every module.

## Contents

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [catalog.md](catalog.md) | Full module catalog grouped by layer |
| [execution-contract.md](execution-contract.md) | Shared operational contract between modules and helpers |
| [qa-fix-contract.md](qa-fix-contract.md) | QA fix and validation guidance |
| [skill-optimization-report.md](skill-optimization-report.md) | Skill optimization tracking |

## Why this exists

Modules should stay focused on a single workflow. Shared references are kept here so the repository can reuse the same catalog, execution rules and validation logic without repeating large blocks in every skill.
